labels.USE_NOW: High-value gap with strong evidence. Notify Sean for implementation approval.
labels.TRIAL: Promising idea that needs a bounded prototype, token decision, or browser proof.
labels.WATCH: Retain as research, but do not spend implementation time yet.
labels.REJECT: Conflicts with Swan, duplicates existing value, or lacks enough value to retain.

hard_rules: Labels notify; they never auto-build or auto-promote canon.
Raw copying, fake progress data, inaccessible controls, and Swan canon conflicts are rejected.
Authenticated or client-rendered claims require browser or source evidence; crawler absence is not proof of absence.
A mounted duplicate must demonstrate measurable workflow improvement before implementation.
Client green is a token proposal. Cyberforest operator green is not silently reused in client UI.
